page.overview:
Who is Azita Cruuz?

Azita Cruuz was a human female and smuggler who operated prior to the Clone Wars. She grew up an orphan on in Pelek Baw, the capital of Haruun Kal, living the life of a loner in which her only companion was nature. Cruuz operated as a smuggler, occasionally doing large jobs to stay financially afloat. After hearing rumors of the scientist Dr. Bishop meddling with coaxium, she came to his refinery on the moon Ro Mira to investigate a profitable opportunity. She administered a drug to Bishop to induce a six-month amnesia and stole his supply of and formula for coaxium ultra. Cruuz subsequently made a broadcast soliciting offers to purchase her exclusive supply.

Cruuz's offer garnered attention from both Ro Mira Refinery Security and numerous interested parties. One such party was the Jedi Order, who hoped to keep coaxium ultra out of the hands of criminal organizations. The Jedi Mace Windu found Cruuz at a Ro Mira hospital and convinced her to hear out his offer. The pair traversed through the moon's ice caves to reach Cruuz's hidden speeder, which they took to Ro Mira's Radial Spaceport, where her freighter waited. To survive an attack from the Anzellan bounty hunter Yaya Shram, Cruuz agreed to exclusively sell to the Jedi.

At the spaceport Cruuz and Windu were attacked by two Dusk Weavers of the Had'le Path cult. Cruuz was able to take out one. When the Had'le Path leader known as "The Shroud" attacked Windu, Cruuz took the Jedi's interceptor to destroy her own ship and save Windu. Fortunately, she still had some coaxium ultra and its formula on her person. She intended to join Windu in a visit to their shared homeworld of Haruun Kal.
